post.title: The loneliest island on Earth 🌊 #geography #maps
post.description: About 250 people live on Tristan da Cunha in the South Atlantic: about 2,400 km from Saint Helena, 2,800 km from South Africa, with no airport. In 1961 the whole island was evacuated after an eruption, and most islanders came back two years later.
post.pinned_comment: Would you live there? Yes or no 👇

scenes.narration: About 250 people live on this tiny island. Their nearest neighbors are an ocean away.
scenes.tts: About two hundred and fifty people live on this tiny island. Their nearest neighbors are an ocean away.

scenes.narration: This is Tristan da Cunha, a lonely volcano in the South Atlantic.

photos.q: Tristan da Cunha island from the sea
photos.caption: TRISTAN DA CUNHA

scenes.narration: The nearest inhabited island, Saint Helena, is about 2,400 kilometers away.
scenes.tts: The nearest inhabited island, Saint Helena, is about two thousand four hundred kilometers away.

scenes.narration: Africa is about 2,800 kilometers away. And there's no airport.
scenes.tts: Africa is about two thousand eight hundred kilometers away. And there's no airport.

scenes.narration: The only way in is a week-long boat trip from Cape Town, if the weather even lets you land.

icons.ai: a cute cartoon small red and white ship sailing, side view
icons.name: ship

scenes.narration: In 1816, Britain put soldiers here, partly so the French couldn't use it to rescue Napoleon.
scenes.tts: In eighteen sixteen, Britain put soldiers here, partly so the French couldn't use it to rescue Napoleon.

photos.caption: NAPOLEON

scenes.narration: When they left, one soldier, William Glass, stayed. Settlers and shipwrecked sailors joined him.

icons.ai: a cute cartoon old-fashioned British soldier from the 1800s in a red coat, standing, friendly face
icons.name: soldier

scenes.narration: Today, everyone lives in one small village, and the whole island shares only about eight family names.

photos.q: Edinburgh of the Seven Seas Tristan da Cunha
photos.caption: THE ONLY VILLAGE

scenes.narration: In 1961, the volcano behind the village erupted, and the whole island was evacuated to England.
scenes.tts: In nineteen sixty one, the volcano behind the village erupted, and the whole island was evacuated to England.

photos.q: Queen Mary's Peak Tristan da Cunha
photos.caption: QUEEN MARY'S PEAK

scenes.narration: They could have stayed in England for good. But two years later, most of them came back.
No airport, no neighbors, a week at sea. Would you live here? Yes or no?
